BrochureContent.Content:
We are delighted to present 'Slieve League House', a renowned and established boutique guesthouse property in Croaghlin, Teelin. Positioned on the main access route to the spectacular Slieve League Cliffs — one of Ireland's great natural attractions. Extending to approximately 3,603 square feet, this substantial property was built in 2004 and is presented in immaculate condition, offering spacious and versatile accommodation with 10 bedrooms (9 of which are en-suite), generous reception and dining areas, and excellent potential for a variety of tourism or lifestyle uses. 

Set on approximately 4.5 acres, the property enjoys an elevated and peaceful setting with ample off-road parking and grounds that could offer future development if desired. A large detached garage to the rear is currently being completed to provide additional two-bedroom accommodation, further adding to the property's appeal. Located just a few hundred metres from the Slieve League viewing platform, the property benefits from consistently high numbers of tourist footfall, an established reputation and excellent online reviews. 

Combining a successful tourism business with substantial residential accommodation in a truly outstanding location, Slieve League House represents a rare opportunity to acquire a property with genuine lifestyle and business potential at one of Ireland's most spectacular coastal destinations. Viewing is highly recommended and is available by appointment only.

Ten-bedroom boutique guest accommodation.

THE OPPORTUNITY
This is an exceptional and versatile property in one of Ireland's most spectacular and sought-after tourism locations. Slieve League House presents a truly unique opportunity to acquire an established guest accommodation business with outstanding potential for a range of tourism, lifestyle or residential uses.

THE POSSIBILITIES
BOUTIQUE GUESTHOUSE
Build on an already established success. Continue and further develop the property's successful guesthouse business, capitalising on its exceptional location and good reputation.

WALKING LODGE
A natural base for adventure. Create a destination for walkers and outdoor enthusiasts, ideally positioned for exploring Slieve League and other spectacular destinations on the Wild Atlantic Way.

RETREAT CENTRE
A peaceful space to escape, recharge and reconnect. The property's private setting, generous accommodation and surrounding landscape provide an inspiring backdrop for wellness or creative retreats.

COOKERY SCHOOL
A taste of Donegal, in an extraordinary setting. The property provides an opportunity to develop a distinctive culinary destination, combining accommodation, food and the charming character of the surrounding region.

EXCLUSIVE-USE ACCOMMODATION
With ten bedrooms, generous living space and extensive grounds, Slieve League House offers remarkable flexibility for private groups, celebrations, gatherings and bespoke stays.

PRIVATE RESIDENCE
A home with room to dream. A substantial and versatile residence offering exceptional space, extensive grounds and an unrivalled setting beside one of Ireland's great natural attractions.

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS
Built in 2004 with a total floor area of approximately 3,603 square feet.
Elevated site in a peaceful yet highly convenient location.
Oil-fired central heating with underfloor heating on both floors.
Concrete floor between ground and first floors.
PVC double-glazed windows throughout.
Positioned directly on The Wild Atlantic Way with The Rusty Mackerel bar approximately 10 minutes' walk away.
Generous plot extending to approximately 4.54 acres with stone-chipped driveway and large guest car park.
Detached garage extending to approximately 1,496 square feet, with potential for additional living accommodation (not fully finished internally).
Long-established and successful guest accommodation with numerous repeat guests.
Slieve League B&B is a registered trade name, providing an established identity and valuable advertising advantage.

TEN BEDROOMS • SET ON 4.54 ACRES • ESTABLISHED TOURISM LOCATION • WILD ATLANTIC WAY • SLIEVE LEAGUE •
